t: Two words he said when people came asking on behalf of others
a: اشْفَعُوا تُشَفَّعُوا وَيَقْضِي اللَّهُ عَزَّ وَجَلَّ عَلَى لِسَانِ نَبِيِّهِ مَا شَاءَ
p: Ishfaʿū tushaffaʿū, wa yaqḍi-Llāhu ʿalā lisāni nabiyyihi mā shāʾ
m: Intercede, and your intercession will be accepted. And Allah decides on the tongue of His Prophet whatever He wills.
